pairs: And the Lord said to me:
“Take up for yourself a large book,
et scribe in eo stylo hominis:
and with a man’s pen write in it:
And I summoned to myself faithful witnesses:
And I joined with the prophetess,
and gave birth to a son.
And the Lord said to me:
quia antequam sciat puer vocare patrem suum et matrem suam,
For before the boy knows how to call to his father and his mother,
auferetur fortitudo Damasci, et spolia Samariæ,
the strength of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria will be taken away,
in the sight of the king of the Assyrians.”
Et adjecit Dominus loqui ad me adhuc,
And the Lord spoke to me further,
Pro eo quod abjecit populus iste aquas Siloë,
“Because this people has cast aside the waters of Shiloah,
propter hoc ecce Dominus adducet super eos aquas fluminis fortes et multas,
for this reason, behold, the Lord will lead over them the waters of a river,
the king of the Assyrians with all his glory.
et ascendet super omnes rivos ejus,
And he will rise up throughout all his streams,
et fluet super universas ripas ejus;
and he will overflow all his banks.
And he will pass through Judah,
and he will cross over and arrive,
Et erit extensio alarum ejus implens latitudinem terræ tuæ,
even at its neck. And he will extend his wings, filling the breadth of your land,
and it will not be done!
Hæc enim ait Dominus ad me:
For the Lord said this to me,
Sicut in manu forti erudivit me,
and he has instructed this to me with a strong hand,
ne irem in via populi hujus,
lest I go forth in the way of this people,
omnia enim quæ loquitur populus iste,
For all that this people speaks is a conspiracy.
conjuratio est: et timorem ejus ne timeatis, neque paveatis.
And you should not be frightened or alarmed with their fear.
Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself.
and let him be your fear.
And so shall he be a sanctification to you.
But he will be a stone of offense
and a rock of scandal to the two houses of Israel,
in laqueum et in ruinam habitantibus Jerusalem.
and a ruin to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And very many of them will stumble
seal the law, among my disciples.”
Et exspectabo Dominum qui abscondit faciem suam a domo Jacob,
And I will wait for the Lord, who has concealed his face from the house of Jacob,
and I will stand before him.
Ecce ego et pueri mei quos dedit mihi Dominus in signum,
Behold: I and my children, whom the Lord has given to me as a sign and a portent,
et in portentum Israël a Domino exercituum,
in Israel, from the Lord of hosts,
And though they say to you,
Quærite a pythonibus et a divinis qui strident in incantationibus suis:
“Seek from seers and diviners,” they who hiss in their incantations,
numquid non populus a Deo suo requiret,
should not the people seek from their God, for the sake of the living,
ad legem magis et ad testimonium.
And this is, moreover, for the sake of the law and the testimony.
Quod si non dixerint juxta verbum hoc,
But if they do not speak according to this Word,
then he will not have the morning light.
And he will pass by it;
and he will speak evil against his king
and he will lift himself upward.
And he will gaze downward to the earth,
et non poterit avolare de angustia sua.
For he will not be able to fly away from its distress.
